=== DOCS-VERIFICATION FINDINGS (trino.io/docs/467/sql/select.html) ===
Verified verbatim: 'When a GROUP BY clause is used in a SELECT statement all output expressions must be either aggregate functions or columns present in the GROUP BY clause.' Confirmed via WebFetch on 2026-06-08. The error Trino raises in violation is of the form: '\'email\' must be an aggregate expression or appear in GROUP BY clause'. Also verified at trino.io/docs/467/functions/aggregate.html that arbitrary(x) exists and returns 'an arbitrary non-null value of x, if one exists. Identical to any_value().' — valid as a Remedy-2 aggregate wrapper. min(x) / max(x) likewise return one value per group ('the minimum/maximum value of all input values').
